learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to derive the mathematical equations describing fluid flow behavior and apply them to examples.
He/She can name the characteristic properties of fluids and distinguish between flow states.
The student is able to determine flow parameters for basic application cases.
This includes the calculation of static and dynamic forces acting on solids from the fluid.
This includes the calculation of two-dimensional viscous flows.
This includes the calculation of lossless incompressible and compressible flows (stream filament theory).
This includes the calculation of loss-affected technical pipe flows.

syllabus_topics: Conservation of angular momentum and energy
Integral form of the conservation equations
Force transmission between fluids and solids
Analytical solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations
assessment_rules: The module grade is determined by the grade of the examination. The module, including all coursework, examinations, and courses, is offered in German for the Bachelor's program in Mechanical Engineering. For the Bachelor's program in Mechanical Engineering (International), it is offered in English.
